我还以为是减速带呢！（我还以为是减速带呢！（第22页）“啊！！！”他被陨石砸中了。虽然关键时候又启动了一招，但也只是保住了他的命，没能对陨石造成一点阻碍。“轰隆隆！！”陨石落在了阿尔巴城的中心广场。这座繁华的翼界大城市，当场被毁了一半，化作漆黑的大坑。爆炸的烟尘之中，一道身影缓缓走出。火焰沾身而不燃，烟尘环绕而不染。此人宛若天神临尘，带着无与伦比的神性。就在城中幸存的人想要给他下跪的时候，众人却发现他没有翅膀。“哦，伟大的福瑞神，没有翅膀的都是异族，肯定不是天神。”“是的，他一定是来自天外的魔鬼。”“我听说过域外天魔的传说，这家伙会不会是域外天魔呢？”来人正是陈奕。穿越位面的时候出了一点小意外。为了更安全的降落——主要是为了这个位面的安全，不是为了他自己。他动用了炎族的天赋，将自己包裹在火焰中，然后自由落体。砸到哪算哪。陈奕一甩手，神力气浪吹走满城烟尘，让四周的视野恢复清明。“这儿社会地位最高的人是谁？”陈奕一张口，标准的翼族语言，因为词条“无障碍交流”。周围的翼族人小心翼翼的围了过来。“他说的是我们的语言。”“难道他也是翼族？”“好像就比我们少了翅膀，莫非是隐藏起来了？还是被人砍掉了？”陈奕听周围的翼族叽叽喳喳，但是没人回答他的问题，那为数不多的耐心转眼就没了。他一抬手，施展星河神功，展现出了对重力的极致控制。围观众翼族的翅膀上，羽毛全被吸到了地上。他们全被拔毛了，成了秃子。“啊啊啊！我的翅膀！！！”对翼族来说，羽毛是神圣的，他们每天都要清洁和保养自己的羽毛，将他们梳的整整齐齐，一根压着一根。没有羽毛，还会导致他们暂时失去飞行能力。陈奕声音不高，但这次没人敢不理他。“这里谁的社会地位最高？”所有人的手齐刷刷的指向，刚刚被陈奕撞了一下，到现在都没缓过来的索托斐仁。索托斐仁躺在废墟里，他已经站不起来了，只能举手说道。“我，我，我是这儿的城主……敢问，阁下，是，是何方神圣？”陈奕朝着他大步走去。“人族，护道者，陈奕！”陈奕主打一个直言不讳，无所畏惧。走近一看，陈奕发现这家伙只有凝神境修为。“境界这么低？这城里比你境界高的有一大把，你真是城主？”“本，本来是武神的，刚刚被您老撞了一下，修为撞散了，就剩这点了……”“哦……我说刚刚下落的时候，好像碰到了什么，我还以为是……算了，告诉我，这个世界的最高统治者是谁，或者你认不认识护道者？”索托斐仁深知陈奕的恐怖，不敢有丝毫欺瞒，知无不言。“翼界如今的共主是福瑞神，他就是你口中的‘最高统治者’，虽然他并不统治什么，至于护道者大人……我曾远远见过一眼，我和他应该不算认识。”

Chapter 453 I thought it was a speed bump (Page 1)
I thought it was a speed bump! (I thought it was a speed bump! (Page 22) "Ah!!!" He was hit by the meteorite. Although he launched another move at the critical moment, it only saved his life and failed to cause any hindrance to the meteorite. "Boom!!" The meteorite fell on the central square of Alba City. This prosperous Wing Realm city was half destroyed on the spot and turned into a big black pit. Amid the smoke and dust of the explosion, a figure slowly walked out. . The flames touch the body without burning, and the smoke surrounds the dust. This man is like a god coming from the dust, with unparalleled divinity. Just when the survivors in the city wanted to kneel down to him, everyone found that he had no wings. "Oh, the great god Furui, those without wings are definitely not gods." "Yes, he must be a devil from outside the world." "I have heard of the legend of the devil from outside the world. Could this guy be a god from outside the world? Where is the demon? "The person who came was Chen Yi. There was a little accident while traveling through the plane. In order to land more safely - mainly for the safety of this plane, not for himself. He used the talent of the Yan tribe to wrap himself in flames and then fell freely. It didn't matter where it hit. Chen Yi waved his hand, and the wave of divine power blew away the smoke and dust in the city, restoring clarity to the surrounding vision. "Who has the highest social status here? Chen Yi opened his mouth and spoke the standard Yi Clan language, because the term "unobstructed communication". The surrounding Yi Clan people gathered around cautiously. "He is speaking our language." "Is he also a Yi Clan?" "Okay. It seems like it has fewer wings than us. Could it be that it was hidden? Or was it chopped off?" Chen Yi heard the chirping of the Wing Clan around him, but no one answered his question, and his little patience was gone in the blink of an eye. He raised his hand and displayed the ultimate control of gravity. The feathers on the wings of the onlookers were all sucked to the ground. They were all plucked and became bald. "Ah! My wings!!!" To the Wing Tribe, feathers are sacred. They have to clean and maintain their feathers every day, combing them neatly one by one. Without feathers, they will temporarily lose their feathers. Flying ability. Chen Yi's voice was not loud, but no one dared to ignore him this time. "Who has the highest social status here?" Everyone pointed at Sotoferen who had just been hit by Chen Yi and had not recovered yet. Sotoferen was lying in the ruins. He could no longer stand up and could only raise his hands and said. "I, I am the city lord here... May I ask, sir, who is it?" Chen Yi strode towards him. Let's go. "Human Race, Protector of the Way, Chen Yi!" Chen Yi said bluntly and fearlessly. Looking closer, Chen Yi found that this guy only has a cultivation level of Concentration Realm? This city is higher than yours. There are a lot of them. Are you really the city lord?" "I was originally a Martial God. I was just hit by you, and my cultivation was shattered. This is all that's left..." "Oh... I said that when I fell, I seemed to have encountered something. Well, I thought it was... Forget it, tell me, who is the supreme ruler of this world, or do you know the protector? " Sotoferen is well aware of Chen Yi's terror and does not dare to deceive him at all. "The current co-owner of the Wing Realm is God Furui, and he is the 'supreme ruler' in your mouth. Although he does not rule anything, as for the protector... I have seen him from a distance, so I don't think I know him. "
